 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    rectangles = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            ys = [p[0] for p in cells]
            xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
            y0, y1, x0, x1 = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
            area = (y1 - y0 + 1) * (x1 - x0 + 1)
            if (area >= 10 and y1 > y0 and x1 > x0 and
                    len(cells) / area >= 0.5):
                rectangles.append((y0, y1, x0, x1, color))
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for y0, y1, x0, x1, color in rectangles:
        for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
            for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
"
